description: This file defines the 'ClientConfigCustomizer' interface with a method to customize configuration and a static method to copy resources from the classpath into a specific directory structure, mainly for setting up configuration files.

classes.name: ClientConfigCustomizer
classes.description: An interface for customizing client configuration with a method to perform customization and a static utility method to copy configuration resources.

methods.name: customizeConfig
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented for customizing configuration within a specified directory.

methods.name: copyConfigToStorageNamespace
methods.description: Static method that copies resources matching a pattern from the classpath to a specified storage namespace directory within the configuration directory.
